_comment: Example hook registration for the buzai trust gate. MERGE this into your workspace's .claude/settings.json (do not blindly overwrite an existing settings.json). PreToolUse: the matcher '*' routes every tool call through the gate (trust/bin/gate). UserPromptSubmit: marks each turn's provenance as owner before any tool calls (trust/bin/mark-turn), so the gate can resolve the owner tier. Both commands run under the pinned, self-contained .venv Python (see docs/SETUP.md step 5) rather than the host's system python. See trust/README.md.
